title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Analista de Investimento Junior
description:
Realizar acompanhamento da performance de ativos, fundos, carteiras administradas, estratégias e perfis de investimento;

Apoiar na preparação de materiais técnicos e apresentações para Comitês de Investimentos, Diretoria e Conselhos;

Responsável por executar as liquidações/boletagens das operações da área de investimentos, conforme procedimento interno e do custodiante;

Realizar, AP, GR e RCS da área conforme procedimentos interno;

Monitorar os saldos diários das carteiras e realizar as transferências entre contas e veículos de investimento, possibilitando a adequada alocação de recursos e a cobertura das necessidades de caixa dos planos;

Cadastrar nos sistemas internos e no banco custodiante, as operações realizadas (compra e venda de ativos, aportes e resgates de fundos, recebimento de juros e amortizações, vencimentos e demais eventos), visando à geração de carteiras atualizadas e aderentes à posição econômica dos planos;

Executar a geração e a conferência das posições de investimentos no banco custodiante, possibilitando que os relatórios reflitam corretamente os ativos, saldos e movimentações de cada plano e carteira;

Efetuar o cálculo, o registro contábil e a análise das taxas de custódia incidentes sobre as carteiras, acompanhando os débitos efetuados pelo banco custodiante e verificando a conformidade dos valores cobrados com os contratos e tabelas vigentes;

Acessar os sistemas de controle interno para registrar valores recebidos e/ou pagos (aportes, resgates, juros, amortizações, taxas, entre outros), possibilitando a correta classificação e conciliação das movimentações financeiras;

Apoiar a implantação, adaptação e utilização de sistemas internos relacionados ao controle de investimentos.

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

Job Type: Contract

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)

  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!


We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.


You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.


As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.


Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.


What You’ll Do:

  • Lead structured interviews and workshops with domain heads and SMEs to capture current-state (“as-is”) processes, data flows, and pain points
  • Translate business needs into clear product capabilities, outcomes, and success measures
  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs
  • Work closely with Solution Architects to ensure technical feasibility, scalability, and long-term sustainability
  • Act as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams, driving clarity and momentum
  • Lead demos, clarify scope boundaries, and align expectations on custom vs configurable functionality
  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026


What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus
  • Experience working with dashboards, BI tools, or custom reporting solutions


Why Join the Remobi community:

  • Fully remote B2B / freelance contracts
  • Access to high-impact roles across AI, FinTech, and modern infrastructure
  • A strong community of senior engineers, curated content, and role alerts
  • Work with fast-scaling companies where your impact is visible and valued


Apply today:

If you’re a Digital Business Analyst who thrives in discovery, enjoys shaping products from complex operational environments, and wants to deliver measurable business value in the energy sector - we’d love to hear from you.

title: Level 1 Support Specialist
description:
Level 1 IT Support Specialist (SAP Experience Required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract - 3 months initially

Daily Rate: €60 – €70 per day

Job Overview

We are looking for a Level 1 IT Support Specialist to join our team and provide first-line technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have basic experience with SAP systems and a strong customer-focused mindset. You will be responsible for handling initial support requests, troubleshooting common issues, and escalating more complex problems when necessary.


  • Provide first-level technical support via phone, email, or ticketing system
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic IT and SAP-related issues
  • Log, track, and manage support tickets in the system
  • Escalate unresolved or complex issues to Level 2 support teams
  • Assist users with SAP login issues, navigation, and basic functionality
  • Maintain accurate documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Follow standard support procedures and service level agreements (SLAs)


Requirements

  • Basic experience working with SAP (any module is a plus)
  • Previous experience in IT support, helpdesk, or customer service role preferred
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Basic knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, and common IT tools
  • Good organizational and time management skills
  • High level of English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Zendesk)
  • Understanding of ITIL principles
  • Multilingual skills (if applicable)

description:
Job Title: Senior AI Engineer – Agentic AI (AWS Bedrock)

Location: Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Contract Position


Engagement Term: 15 months

Role Summary

  • Senior AI Engineer focused on Agentic AI and LLM/GenAI solutions
  • Hands-on engineering role supporting large-scale enterprise AI use cases
  • Offshore AI/LLM execution partner to a highly technical onshore Architect
  • Expected to own and deliver the most critical AI use cases , not support work


Core Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Agentic AI solutions using AWS Bedrock
  • Apply MCP (Model Context Protocol) to structure and manage AI-agent interactions
  • Build and deploy AI layers on top of AWS services
  • Translate business requirements into AI architecture and technical implementation plans
  • Lead solutioning efforts: refining ideas into clear, executable technical plans
  • Implement chatbots and analyst-style agents for complex unstructured data (text + images)
  • Support “what-if” analysis use cases , including scenario modeling and decision support
  • Deliver scalable, production-ready AI solutions aligned to enterprise standards


Business Context – Network Planning

  • Primary focus area: Network Planning business
  • Ensuring all global flights are planned, analyzed, and optimized
  • Supporting large-scale, data-heavy decision-making across airline operations
  • AI solutions will augment planning, analysis, and insight generation for complex global datasets

title: Analista Contábil Pleno
description:
Somos uma fintech que oferece soluções completas de gestão financeira para micro, pequenos e médios empresários de diversos segmentos. Estamos em constante crescimento e sempre em busca de novos talentos!


Analista Contábil Pleno


Responsabilidades:


  • Executar rotinas contábeis completas, incluindo classificação, conciliação e análise de contas patrimoniais e de resultado;
  • Realizar conciliação contábil e financeira de operações com cartões, incluindo bandeiras (Visa, Mastercard, Elo, etc.), adquirentes e subadquirentes;
  • Controlar e conciliar contas de liquidação, agenda financeira, taxas (taxa de Desconto do Comerciante), chargebacks e antecipações;
  • Atuar no fechamento contábil mensal, garantindo acuracidade das informações;
  • Elaborar e revisar demonstrações financeiras (BP, DRE, DFC);
  • Garantir aderência às normas contábeis (CPC/IFRS) e regulamentações do Banco Central;
  • Apoiar na elaboração e envio de relatórios regulatórios ao Bacen, quando aplicável;
  • Atender auditorias internas e externas;
  • Mapear e propor melhorias nos processos de conciliação e controles financeiros;
  • Interagir com áreas internas (financeiro, operações, produtos) e parceiros externos (bandeiras, adquirentes).


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência em instituições de pagamento, fintechs ou adquirentes ;
  • Vivência com operações de cartões e conciliações financeiras (bandeiras, liquidação, chargeback, MDR);
  • Conhecimento das normas do Banco Central aplicáveis a instituições de pagamento;
  • Experiência com fechamento contábil e conciliações em volume;
  • Excel intermediário/avançado.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento em arranjos de pagamento e fluxo de liquidação financeira;
  • Vivência com reportes regulatórios ao Bacen;
  • Conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de análise de dados;

Atualmente, estamos em busca de um Executivo Comercial para integrar nossa equipe do Comercial Biodiesel na unidade de Porto Alegre.


  • Prospectar, captar e reter clientes no segmento de distribuição de combustíveis, por meio de análise de mercado, visitas presenciais e ações de desenvolvimento comercial;
  • Assegurar a execução integral dos contratos firmados, realizando o acompanhamento das retiradas semanais e propondo soluções comerciais ou logísticas para garantir a entrega dos volumes contratados;
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com contas estratégicas, contribuindo para ampliar o share of wallet e apoiar as metas de crescimento da companhia;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais de longo prazo, incluindo contratos estruturados (frames), rebates, metas de performance e outras modalidades estratégicas de venda. Além de identificar oportunidades comerciais para diversificação de mercados e portfólio de clientes;
  • Avaliar, propor e apoiar a implementação de soluções logísticas (ex.: cabotagem, entregas CIF, pontos avançados de entrega), por meio de estudos internos e/ou consultorias especializadas, visando aumentar a eficiência logística e a rentabilidade das operações;
  • Acompanhar tendências do mercado nacional e internacional de biodiesel e de biocombustíveis, por meio de estudos, publicações especializadas e interação com potenciais clientes no exterior. Identificar oportunidades comerciais que contribuam para a diversificação de mercados e fortalecimento da presença da companhia no mercado;
  • Apoiar decisões relacionadas ao gerenciamento de risco do biodiesel, com base em análises de mercado, publicações especializadas e contato com formadores de opinião nos mercados de combustíveis, óleos vegetais, gorduras e demais ativos que influenciam custos e preços;
  • Contribuir nas avaliações de aquisição de matéria-prima para biodiesel, participando de análises de mercado, contato com fornecedores e acompanhamento de negociações relevantes junto ao time de compras;
  • Contribuir para discussões de otimização da performance industrial nos processos de S&OP, assegurando a aderência entre qualidade e volumes negociados.


Requisitos

  • Será considerado como diferencial ter conhecimento na língua Inglesa avançado ou fluente;
  • Conhecimento em precificação de commodities agrícolas e/ou combustíveis;
  • Experiência em vendas/negociação B2B, preferencialmente no setor de combustíveis ou de comodities;
  • Capacidade de realizar estudos de mercado, interpretar publicações especializadas e identificar tendências;
  • Conhecimento em soluções logísticas (cabotagem, CIF, pontos avançados de entrega);
  • Familiaridade com ativos como óleos vegetais, gorduras, basis, entre outros;
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, rebates, metas de performance e estratégias comerciais;
  • Desejável experiência com clientes internacionais e entendimento de práticas de exportação.


Formação

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, C. Contábeis, Economia ou Engenharias.
  • Desejável Especialização na Área de Negócios e/ou Finanças.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Associate Account Executive - Biopharma
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior - Francês Canadense - Remoto
description:
Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior, HCLTech



Brasil (Remoto) / Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior / Integral


Somos a HCLTech, uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia e DSA que mais crescem no mundo, com mais de 219.000 profissionais espalhados em 54 países, impulsionando o progresso através de recursos líderes do segmento e centrados nas áreas de Digital, Engenharia e Nuvem.


A força motriz por trás desse trabalho, nosso pessoal, é um público diversificado, criativo e apaixonado, o que nos possibilita estar sempre elevando o padrão de excelência de nossos serviços. De nosso lado, trabalhamos para que cada um de nossos profissionais possa atingir seu melhor, ao mesmo tempo em que nos esforçamos para ajudá-los a encontrar sua inspiração diária e, assim, se tornar a melhor versão de si mesmos.


Estamos à procura de um Analista de Service Desk Trilingue Sênior altamente talentoso e automotivado para se juntar a nós em nossa jornada para avançar no mundo tecnológico por meio da inovação e criatividade.


Seu Papel & Responsabilidades:


• Fornecer diagnóstico / resolução de problemas de hardware / software / rede via telefone, chat e e-mail para os usuários finais do cliente.

• Resolver ou encaminhar incidentes e solicitações para as equipes apropriadas.

• Coordenar e gerenciar relacionamentos com fornecedores e equipes de suporte que fornecem resolução de problemas de hardware / software / rede.

• Administrar e fornecer controles de acesso e saída do usuário.

• Participar de treinamento prático e comercial projetado para aprimorar habilidades e recursos de suporte.

• Disposto a trabalhar em diferentes turnos e feriados nacionais, conforme exigido pelas Operações.

• Indicar procedimentos faltantes para a equipe de gestão a fim de melhorar a documentação.

• Atuar com excelência como ponto focal para problemas e solicitações do usuário final


Qualificações & Experiência


  • FRANCÊS CANADENSE nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Português nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Inglês nível AVANÇADO (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Experiência com Suporte remoto.


Por que nos escolher?


  • Somos uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia que mais crescem no mundo, com escritórios em mais de 54 países e 219.000 colaboradores
  • Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas
  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo
  • Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho virtual em primeiro lugar, promovendo uma boa integração entre seu trabalho e vida pessoal, em uma flexibilidade real
  • Estamos comprometidos com seu crescimento, oferecendo oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento de carreira em todos os níveis para ajudá-lo a encontrar seu brilho único.
  • Oferecemos benefícios abrangentes para todos os funcionários
  • Somos certificados como \"Great Place to Work\" e \"Top Employer\" em 17 países, e reconhecidos como “Top Employer” no Brasil especificamente, oferecendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo que valoriza o reconhecimento e o respeito dos funcionários


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation.   • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;

  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;

title: Consultor Óptico
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a \"verem mais e serem mais\" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.


Responsabilidade da posição:

- Apresentação dos produtos e lançamentos, todos embasados em materiais científicos, estabelecidos pela empresa;

- Planejar um roteiro eficiente e visitar os médicos ativos de acordo com a meta e direcionamento estabelecido

- Identificar novos médicos potenciais, assim como segmentar a carteira com frequência

- Divulgar e gerar demanda de vendas para o portfólio da empresa (lentes e equipamentos);

- Divulgação e implementação de material promocional para a divulgação dos produtos no consultório;

- Desenvolvimento de projetos específicos para atender a demanda dos clientes;

- Criação de campanhas individualizadas, para clientes, no intuito da flexibilização e fidelização dos mesmos;

- Presença no dia a dia, frequência e sequência na carteira, identificando sempre as suas necessidades e criando maior relacionamento;

- Organização e realização de eventos locais para treinamento de médicos com os produtos a fim de ampliar os objetivos a serem alcançado;

- Ministrar apresentações para grupos de médicos e residentes dos nossos produtos e tecnologias;

- Participação nas feiras e congressos quando necessário em sua área.


Requisitos da posição:

-Nível superior completo

-Pacote office intermediário

-Disponibilidade para viagens

-Experiência com sistemas CRM

-Experiência com atendimento ao perfil médico

-Conhecimento no ramo óptico ou oftalmologia será considerado um diferencial.

-CNH B


*A Essilorluxottica valoriza e apoia a diversidade, por esse motivo, todas as nossas vagas são abertas para candidaturas de profissionais PCDs.

Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable RESTful or GraphQL APIs consumed by Android and iOS clients
  • Build and maintain microservices using Java, Node.js, Python, or Go (per team stack)
  • Define and document API contracts and data schemas in collaboration with mobile developers
  • Manage database design, query optimization, and migrations (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices (OAuth 2.0, JWT)
  • Develop and maintain backend test suites; collaborate with SDETs on integration testing
  • Maintain JIRA user stories and technical tasks for backend workstream
  • Monitor service health, diagnose production issues, and lead root cause analysis
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for backend services
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and technical planning sessions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language: Java, Node.js (TypeScript), Python, or Go
  • Strong experience designing and building RESTful APIs for mobile clients
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes or ECS)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Familiarity with JIRA for backlog and sprint management
  • Understanding of security practices: OAuth, JWT, HTTPS, input validation
  • Experience with automated testing and integration with CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong commitment to Test Driven Development (TDD) practices for backend service quality
  • Experience building backends specifically optimized for mobile (bandwidth-efficient, low-latency APIs)
  • Familiarity with push notification infrastructure (FCM, APNs)
  • Knowledge of event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS/SNS)
  • Exposure to GraphQL API design


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as AbbVie, Astrazeneca, Pfizer, Merck. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


Our Biopharma team is growing, and we are looking for an experienced Associate Account Executive to expand institutional sales of our scientific video journal and databases to biopharma companies in North America. If you are ambitious, results-driven, and can develop relationships with scientists and progress opportunities, this position could be an excellent opportunity for you.


Responsibilities:


  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing business for assigned biopharma accounts.
  • Conduct active outreach to build and progress opportunities in the pipeline to meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Build and execute a persistent outbound sales strategy, including cold calls and emails, to generate interest and accelerate new business generation.
  • Establish and maintain strong and professional relationships with biopharma librarians, R&D leadership and stakeholders.
  • Work with the marketing and customer success teams to customize marketing activities & provide support for each account.


Requirements:


  • A bachelor's degree
  • 2+ years of direct selling experience to stakeholders in the pharmaceutical, biotech, device, or healthcare industry.
  • Demonstrated success in meeting and exceeding sales objectives.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and manage a full sales cycle.
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • A disciplined approach to daily activity planning, setting goals, and achieving success.
  • Experience with Salesforce or relevant sales CRM, MS Office is required.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package, including unlimited commissions.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and productivity.
  • Opportunity to work in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • FRANCÊS CANADENSE nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)
  • Português nível AVANÇADO/FLUENTE (comunicação, escrita e leitura)

  • Nossa empresa é extremamente diversificada com 165 nacionalidades representadas
  • Oferecemos a oportunidade de trabalhar com colegas espalhados ao redor do mundo

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Sourcer Júnior Latam
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Sourcer Júnior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratações LATAM da AI/R Company. Empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL fazem parte do grupo.

Você irá apoiar o mapeamento de mercado, a identificação de talentos e a construção de pipelines, atuando em parceria com recrutadores para contribuir com processos mais assertivos e uma boa experiência para os candidatos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Apoiar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);
  • Utilizar estratégias de sourcing com apoio do time;
  • Criar e manter listas e pipelines de talentos organizados;
  • Realizar primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando oportunidades;
  • Atualizar e manter informações em ferramentas como ATS e LinkedIn;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com recrutadores e lideranças para entender perfis e prioridades;
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios simples de recrutamento;
  • Contribuir com ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência com recrutamento, sourcing ou pesquisa de talentos;
  • Experiência trabalhando com SLA curto de entrega de candidatos;
  • Interesse por tecnologia e pelo mercado de talentos tech;
  • Familiaridade com LinkedIn ou outras plataformas de busca de perfis;
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e curiosidade por desafios;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Inglês avançado para conversação.



A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Arquitetura de Segurança Cloud AWS - 132141
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Segurança/AWS).

Responsabilidades:

Arquiteto especializado em segurança para ambientes financeiros críticos, responsável por definir, validar e garantir controles de segurança fim a fim para cargas de trabalho relacionadas ao PIX na AWS, incluindo integração híbrida com ambientes on-premises, HSM e requisitos regulatórios. Realização de comprovações (POCs) para migração de workloads PIX do mainframe para AWS.

  • Definir arquitetura de segurança alinhada ao AWS Well-Architected Framework (Pilar de Segurança);
  • Projetar estratégia de IAM (federação, RBAC, privilégio mínimo);
  • Definir estratégia de criptografia (em trânsito e em repouso);
  • Integrar soluções HSM (on-prem e cloud);
  • Garantir conformidade com requisitos do BACEN e LGPD;
  • Definir padrões de segurança para containers (EKS/ROSA);
  • Implementar estratégia de segurança multi-conta e landing zone;
  • Conduzir modelagem de ameaças e avaliações de risco;
  • Apoiar POCs com validação de segurança e verificações de conformidade.

Requisitos :

  • AWS IAM, AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM;
  • Criptografia (PKI, TLS, assinaturas digitais);
  • Segurança de APIs (OAuth2, OpenID Connect);
  • Segurança de containers e Kubernetes;
  • Auditoria e logging (CloudTrail, GuardDuty);
  • Arquitetura Zero Trust;
  • Certificações: AWS Security Specialty.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com sistemas financeiros e pagamentos instantâneos (PIX);
  • Integração HSM com requisitos de baixa latência;
  • Segurança para sistemas transacionais de alto throughput;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de prevenção à fraude.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack - Java/Angular - Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga


Código da vaga: 59704


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Principais responsabilidades


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Angular 15+ e Java
  • Experiência com Module Federation e WebView.
  • Testes unitários com Jest/Jasmine.
  • Git/GitHub
  • Testes de Acessibilidade.
  • Conhecimento de IDS / Design System.
  • Docker.
  • Experiência com AWS (CI/CD, S3, ECS, API Gateway, Lambda, Load Balancer e CloudFormation)
  • Terraform para criação e gerenciamento de infraestrutura.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento em Kotlin.
  • Conhecimento em Python.
  • Conhecimento em ReactJS.


Modelo de atuação


  • 100% remoto.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).
